publishedVfrProcedures.contactNote: Before entering TMA Maribor 1&2 contact Maribor Approach. If no reply, contact Ljubljana Approach or Ljubljana Information.
publishedVfrProcedures.routeNote: Enter TMA Maribor 1&2 via entry points GOLVA, MUREG, PETOV, OBUTI, NIDLO, TISKO, DIMLO, MS2, MS3, ME3, ME4, MW1.
publishedVfrProcedures.availabilityNote: Check operating hours for Maribor Approach.
publishedVfrProcedures.note: VFR flights entering via these entry points shall as soon as practicable establish radio contact with Maribor Approach.

publishedVfrProcedures.contactNote: Two-way radio communication required. Contact Maribor Tower 5 MIN prior to reaching the first REP.
publishedVfrProcedures.routeNote: Enter CTR Maribor via REPs and routes as depicted.
publishedVfrProcedures.reportingNote: Primary Maribor CTR REPs shown on the current Jepp terminal VFR chart include OSMOT, LAPNA, MN1, MN2, ME2, MS1, IRLIX, ME1, and MIRSO.

vfrRoutes.note: Jepp 19-1 depicts a named corridor line from MN1 via MN2 toward the main 14/32 circuit NW entry. The circuit-join endpoint is not yet authored as a named anchor.
Jepp 19-1 depicts a corridor from the MW1 TMA entry toward the LAPNA CTR reporting point. The inbound leg onto the airfield itself is not yet authored as a route segment.
